Parameters: cloudfront.net, port 443, GET /.
Request plaintext: bytes 0..255 repeated eight times (2048 bytes).
Response plaintext: "server-first\x00\xff", followed by the same 2048 bytes.
The response fixtures include both the initial response and a subsequent write.

All framing, lengths, extensions, payloads, and fixed protocol bytes are compared.
